title: DASH no longer shows the "silence alert" button to disable pod's alerting beeps
symptom: When the DASH pod is alerting (expiration reminder, shutdown, low reservoir), the 'Silence Alerts' button on the DASH tab is not visible, so the user cannot silence the pod's beeping. The button may flash briefly when opening the DASH tab.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but a commenter suspects a button view problem where the button is initially enabled but then disabled on screen refresh.
fix: A workaround is to go to 'POD MGMT' and tap 'Play Test Beep', which makes the Silence Alert button reappear. A fix is being worked on.
evidence_quote: Silence Alert reappears after going to "POD MGMT" and tapping "Play Test Beep"
